# How a center forms: where a formation's acts return

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`where-a-formations-acts-return` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](where-a-formations-acts-return.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Two formations lie in one loop where each can affect the other. A formation's acts return, all it acts on lying within what it can represent, exactly where its loop is closed under affecting; loops form as links close them, and over finitely many formations every reach holds one.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Two formations lie in one loop where each can affect the other's continuation at some remove: an equivalence, so loops partition the formations; being in a formation's reach is that formation being in one's influence closure. (`Becoming.Flow.InOneLoop`, `Becoming.Flow.InOneLoop.refl`, `Becoming.Flow.InOneLoop.symm`, `Becoming.Flow.InOneLoop.trans`, `Becoming.Flow.withinReach_iff_influence`)
2. A formation's acts return where whatever it can affect can affect it: exactly where everything it reaches lies in its loop, and exactly where its loop is closed under affecting; returning is a property of the loop. (`Becoming.Flow.ReachReturns`, `Becoming.Flow.reachReturns_iff_loop`, `Becoming.Flow.reachReturns_iff_closed`, `Becoming.Flow.ReachReturns.of_loop`)
3. Where acts return, everything acted on lies within the coupling closure, what can be represented, for every coupling by level; with coupling by threshold only, acts return exactly where everything acted on can be represented. (`Becoming.Flow.ReachReturns.represented`, `Becoming.Flow.reachReturns_iff_represented`)
4. Loops only merge as exchange grows, while returning is not monotone: where one formation acts on another that does not act back, the first's acts do not return and the second's do; closing the link makes one loop whose acts return. (`Becoming.Flow.InOneLoop.mono`, `Becoming.Line.open_not_returns`, `Becoming.Line.open_b_returns`, `Becoming.Line.closed_one_loop`, `Becoming.Line.closed_returns`)
5. With finitely many formations listed and reach decided, every formation's reach holds a formation whose acts return. (`Becoming.Flow.exists_reachReturns`, `Becoming.Flow.holdsCount_pos`, `Becoming.Flow.holdsCount_lt`, `Becoming.Flow.search`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Reach and influence are read off one flow and one web through dependence at some step and exchange at some step (Becoming.Feedback). Finitely many formations listed and reach decided where stated.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Whether a returning loop persists along a run: returning is a property of the reach closures of one flow.
- That a returning formation acts for anything: a formation that affects nothing beyond itself returns trivially.
- Which loop a formation draws its own region along when several relations are read.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The strongly connected components of a directed graph and the sink components of its condensation (every finite directed graph has one, reachable from every vertex); in ecology, closed loops of interaction within a food web; in systems theory, operational closure.
